item.title: Coding and Robotics Certifications | Blue Ridge Boost
item.description:
About Our Classes and Certifications

Blue Ridge Boost is proud to offer classes and certifications in robotics and coding. All instructors hold a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and are certified by the Carnegie Mellon Robotics Academy. Both certifications are industry-recognized and approved by the Virginia Department of Education.
We offer separate classes for adults, as well as advanced middle school and high school students.

Please contact us to add classes to the schedule.

Coding Classes

Our coding classes follow the CodeHS curriculum. You can complete the course content on your own or join our classes for an engaging, in-person education. You may sign up for a week or a month (depending on the class) to prepare for the test and complete it in person at Blue Ridge Boost. The certificates for coding are issued by CodeHS.

item.title: Frequently Asked Questions
item.description:
ClassesAges 6+
CampsYear-round
Location2171 Ivy Rd
Contact(434) 260-0636

Classes and Programs

How does a monthly subscription work?
You will be charged a fixed monthly fee from September to November. Makeup sessions will be provided for any classes that fall on holidays. After the three-month period, you'll receive a 10% discount on all non-subscription products purchased.
What ages do you serve?
Our programs are designed for children ages 6 and up. We have different tracks for elementary, middle school, and high school students, each tailored to their developmental level and interests.
What subjects do you teach?
We offer classes in robotics, coding, game design, Minecraft, chess, and more. Our curriculum covers everything from beginner-friendly block coding to advanced programming languages.
Do you offer makeup classes for missed sessions?
Yes, makeup sessions are provided for classes that fall on holidays. For other absences, please contact us to discuss options.

Enrollment and Payment

How do I enroll my child?
You can enroll directly through our website by selecting the class or camp you're interested in and completing the registration process. Payment is due at the time of registration.
What payment methods do you accept?
We accept credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover), debit cards, electronic funds transfer (EFT), and checks.
Do you offer financial assistance?
Yes! We offer scholarships through the Aicha Amira Wade, Marieme Imane Wade, and Omar Wade Memorial Scholarships. Visit our scholarships page to learn more and apply.

Policies

What is your refund policy?
We maintain a no-refund policy for all sales. However, transfers to similar activities may be available. Please see our refund policy for complete details.
What are the attendance limits?
Each child may attend a maximum of 25 days of classes within any three-month period. This is to maintain our exemption from day care licensure and ensure equal access for all students.

Still Have Questions?

We're here to help!

item.title: Upper Elementary Classes | Blue Ridge Boost
Vision and History | Blue Ridge Boost
item.description:
History of Blue Ridge Boost

During the COVID-19 pandemic, I spent a significant amount of time teaching and helping my children learn, and I discovered that I greatly enjoy teaching young students. This newfound passion led me to quit my Ph.D. program in Computer Science to pursue a degree in teaching at the University of Virginia, and I subsequently launched Blue Ridge Boost.

During the lockdown, Maxwell and Dorina enrolled in various challenging and exciting classes offered by the Center for Talented Youth at Johns Hopkins and The Art of Problem Solving. Despite the quality of the instructors, the lack of face-to-face interaction was a significant drawback.
